inbox_items_undelivered_idx.name: inbox_items_undelivered_idx
inbox_items_undelivered_idx.where: "inbox_items"."decision" is not null and "inbox_items"."delivered_at" is null

repos_kind_check.name: repos_kind_check
repos_kind_check.value: ("repos"."kind" = 'local' and "repos"."runner_id" is not null and "repos"."path" is not null) or ("repos"."kind" = 'github' and "repos"."runner_id" is null and "repos"."path" is null and "repos"."github_repo_id" is not null)

workflow_runs_sandbox_behind_idx.name: workflow_runs_sandbox_behind_idx
workflow_runs_sandbox_behind_idx.where: "workflow_runs"."sandbox" is not null and "workflow_runs"."sandbox_observed_generation" is distinct from "workflow_runs"."sandbox_generation" and "workflow_runs"."status" not in ('running', 'waiting_input')
